questions.decision: Default shadow comparison spans two operating weeks and a complete relevant obligation/settlement cycle, whichever is longer, with bounded resources and adequate sample. Shadow has no outward effect authority; longer outcome horizons or missing evidence prevent automatic cutover.
questions.uncertainty: Actual sample and commercial outcome horizon may require longer.
questions.owner: S1-C06 independent evaluation with S1-C04 change authority
questions.falsifying_test: The calendar window ends and activates a system with no mature customer outcomes.

questions.question: How do you compare the new way against the old fairly, rather than against a memory of the old?
questions.status: specified; independent review, implementation and operating evidence pending
questions.decision: Compare S1 and credible S0 on matched tasks and equivalent authority/recovery/rights outcomes with explicit trust assumptions, all retries/refusals/corrections and actual human labor. Do not force identical component inventory or gift S0 free experts; preserve disagreements by dimension.
questions.uncertainty: Neither comparative operating performance nor actual labor fees are known.
questions.owner: S1-C06 independent evaluation with S1-C04 change authority
questions.falsifying_test: The favored architecture receives easier tasks or omitted operating costs.

questions.question: What is the baseline, and was it measured before anything changed?
questions.status: specified; independent review, implementation and operating evidence pending
questions.decision: Freeze prechange task population, source/access conditions, native/manual outcome evidence, due duties, errors, attention and total resource cost. Preserve existing known baseline failures and denominator differences until contract/regression resolution, rather than hardcoding a passing count.
questions.uncertainty: Current baseline diagnostics are observations, not resolved defects.
questions.owner: S1-C06 independent evaluation with S1-C04 change authority
questions.falsifying_test: A corpus mismatch is hidden by changing the expected count to today's value.

questions.question: How do you keep adding without accumulating — does each new part replace something, or merely sit alongside it?
questions.status: specified; independent review, implementation and operating evidence pending
questions.decision: Retire obsolete writers/hooks/agents/tools/providers/accounts after dependency inventory, portable source export, current ownership transfer and native deletion/descendant verification. Preserve necessary evidence and unresolved duties; removal reduces complexity without erasing accountability.
questions.uncertainty: Native deletion and legal retention may delay final retirement.
questions.owner: S1-C06 independent evaluation with S1-C04 change authority
questions.falsifying_test: An unused old credential continues renewing or issuing actions.

questions.question: What would tell you to stop building and start using?
questions.status: specified; independent review, implementation and operating evidence pending
questions.decision: Begin operation only after B10 actual admission and complete construction evidence for its scope; judge real outcomes at B11. Stop discretionary additions when final requirements are satisfied, or replace the architecture when useful progress/affordability/competence falsifiers hold; no endless scaffold completion.
questions.uncertainty: Actual operational and company acceptance are future evidence.
questions.owner: S1-C06 independent evaluation with S1-C04 change authority
questions.falsifying_test: The team keeps adding features while due service fails or declares success from prose.

questions.question: What is the honest sequence, given that some things cannot be built until others exist?
questions.status: specified; independent review, implementation and operating evidence pending
questions.decision: The construction DAG names dependencies and stage tests/integration/completion/risk. B04 can develop against frozen B01 while B02/B03 proceed, but adapters/humans/operations converge before full rehearsal; no unavailable foundation is bypassed for a demonstration.
questions.uncertainty: Interface consistency and all later stage evidence need independent review.
questions.owner: S1-C06 independent evaluation with S1-C04 change authority
questions.falsifying_test: A downstream component invents a second acceptance or authority state machine.
